items.title: This BlackRock strategist opposes a Fed hike. Here are the funds she recommends.
items.content: Gargi Pal Chaudhuri, of BlackRock, recommends investors stay invested in the artificial-intelligence sector but broaden into themes like quality and healthcare.

items.title: ‘I am drowning in debt’: I have $125,000 in credit-card debt. Will $9,000 in disability income affect my bankruptcy?
items.content: “I racked up this debt to cover my living expenses for two years without an income stream.”

items.title: What history says about longer-term bond yields after the first Fed hike
items.content: If the Federal Reserve hikes interest rates in an effort to slow down the rapid rise in longer-term yields, history shows it probably won’t be a success.

items.title: What Altman, Amodei, Huang and Zuckerberg are saying about the raging AI debate
items.content: A product conference at software giant Salesforce turned into the battleground on the new debate on whether there should be a slowdown in artificial intelligence.

items.title: Medicare is using AI to approve claims. The result has been ‘alarmingly high denial rates.’
items.content: A pilot program using artificial intelligence to approve care for Medicare beneficiaries has resulted in high levels of denials and delayed decisions and prompted warnings from a vendor about a lack of readiness, according to a lawsuit seeking information about the program.

items.title: ‘My total balance should be $20 million’: I invested $1.1 million in a crypto platform. Have I lost it all?
items.content: “I invested on the recommendation of an executive vice president of a major New York investment bank.”

items.title: ‘There might be a silver lining’: My friend’s wife died at 60 after a high-earning career. Can he claim her Social Security?
items.content: “They had been married for over 30 years when she passed.”

items.title: These 4 stocks could benefit most from a $3.2 trillion semiconductor opportunity
items.content: A BofA analyst expects the semiconductor market to reach $3.2 trillion by the end of the decade, shrugging off fears of an AI slowdown.

items.title: How the Iran war is transforming the relationship between stocks, bonds and oil
items.content: Oil is increasingly calling the tune in global markets as rising energy prices make investors nervous.

items.title: AI stocks are rebounding. One analyst says there’s no spending slowdown in sight.
items.content: Customers are signing multiyear deals for chips and more: “That’s not what the front end of a downturn looks like.”
